no_cap_limit.meaning: noCapLimit exponent defining the small-market threshold 2^noCapLimit

mint_amount.meaning: amount minted in the single call (100e18 in the scenario)

large_market_growth_bound_satisfied.meaning: whether the mint satisfies the large-market ETWAP growth bound that applies when the resulting post-mint supply makes the market large
large_market_growth_bound_satisfied.checkpoint: evaluation of the mint against the large-market bound

assumptions: The scenario requires no privileged roles, oracle manipulation, or governance actions; only being early to mint when the market is small.
The small-market pre-state is a conditional scenario, not a confirmed live observation.
The mint amount 100e18 exceeds the small-market threshold so the resulting supply makes the market large.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the large-market ETWAP growth bound, so its satisfaction is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric inequality.

limitations: Only the large_growth_bypass impact is formalized; subsequent_mints_revert and deposit_dos are deferred to future claims.
The exact noCapLimit value (60) and its relation to the 2^96 bound are asserted but not independently verified.
The ETWAP lag and time-gating window duration are not quantified.
Code-level binding of the cached pre-state supply and the post-mint re-evaluation is deferred.
